title: Variance of a row of a Rademacher projection
statement:
Fix an integer $k \ge 1$, a vector $x \in \bbr^d$, and a row index $i \in \{1,\dots,k\}$. Let $A$ be the Rademacher matrix drawn from the joint Rademacher product measure, so its $k \cdot d$ entries $A_{ij} = \omega_{ij}/\sqrt{k}$ are independent, each equal to $\pm 1/\sqrt{k}$ with probability $1/2$. Then the $i$-th coordinate of the image $Ax$ has variance
\[
  \mathrm{Var}\!\bigl[(Ax)_i\bigr] = \frac{\norm{x}^2}{k}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: x is a vector in ℝ^d
i is a row index in Fin k
randomness governed by the joint Rademacher product measure
